description.zh:
* 是否需要自动旋转功能，默认不需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. By default, this feature is disabled.  
* true: enables the feature; false: disables the feature.

description.zh:
* 是否按顺序输出文字块，默认为false。
* false表示从左往右，从上到下的顺序；true表示从上到下，从左往右的顺序。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to output text blocks in sequential order. Default value: false.  
* false: outputs text blocks from left to right and top to bottom; true: outputs text blocks from top to bottom and left to right.

description.zh:
* 是否需要去除印章功能，默认不需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to enable stamp removal. By default, this feature is disabled.  
* true: enables the feature; false: disables the feature.

description.zh:
* 是否输出单字识别结果，默认不需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to output single-character recognition results. By default, this is not required.
* true: required; false: not required.

description.zh:
* 是否需要图案检测功能，默认不需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to enable pattern Detection. By default, this feature is disabled.  
* true: enables the feature; false: disables the feature.

description.zh:
* 是否输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息，默认不需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to output table recognition results, including cell information. By default, this is not required.
* true: required; false: not required.

description.zh:
* 是否需要分段功能，默认不需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether paragraph segmentation is required. By default, this is not required.
* true: required; false: not required.

description.zh:
* 是否需要成行返回功能，默认不需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to return results line by line. By default, this feature is disabled.  
* true: enables the feature; false: disables the feature.

description.zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）。
description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You cannot pass through both fields simultaneously or leave both empty.
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* You must specify either this field or the URL field, but not both, and neither can be empty.  
* Binary file of the image, with a maximum size of 10 MB.  
* When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云全文识别高精版，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，智能识别图片所包含的全部字段，集表格识别、旋转识别、生僻字识别等多功能为一体，提供高性价比的多场景文字识别体验。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |多功能集结|集表格识别、旋转识别、生僻字识别等多功能为一体。| |抗干扰|支持多格式版面、复杂文档背景和光照环境的精准识别。| |自动排异|对有印章、手印的文档，可实现印章擦除后识别。| |高阶能力|支持覆盖文字编辑、低置信度过滤、图案检测。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [通用文字识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com?commodityCode=ocr_general_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=universal&subtype=general#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[全文识别高精版资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_general_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_general_dp_cn_20211103172431_0719%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeAdvanced?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |其他提示|
  • 接口响应速度和图片中的文字数量有关，如果图片中文字数量越多，接口响应可能越慢。
  • 接口会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Full-text Recognition (Premium Edition) is an official self-developed OCR product from Alibaba Cloud. It intelligently detects all fields contained in an image, integrating multiple capabilities such as table recognition, rotation recognition, and rare character recognition to deliver a high-value, multi-scenario text recognition experience. * Based on DAMO Academy's powerful AI technology and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR product has been refined over years of development and offers key advantages including service stability, ease of operation, real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Categorization | Overview | |---|---------| | Multifunctional Marshaling | Integrates multiple features such as table recognition, rotation recognition, and rare character recognition into one solution. | | Interference Resistance | Supports accurate recognition across multiple layout formats, complex document backgrounds, and varying lighting environments. | | Automatic Artifact Removal | For documents containing seals or fingerprints, the system can erase seals before performing recognition. | | Advanced Capabilities | Supports features such as overlay text editing, low-confidence filtering, and pattern detection. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [General Text Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com?commodityCode=ocr_general_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test this feature’s recognition performance via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=universal&subtype=general#intro). | | 2 | Purchase the [Full-text Recognition Premium Edition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_general_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_general_dp_cn_20211103172431_0719%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota that you can use for testing. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeAdvanced?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to retrieve the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, your Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see: [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, we recommend that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • API response time depends on the amount of text in the image; more text may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but this may affect accuracy. Whenever possible, use high-definition images without glare or distortion.
|
